errors.text_span: След това линията се покачва до около 24% при година 14
errors.evidence: The description states that for Bulgaria (the blue line), the value rises to about 24% at year 14. However, the chart shows the value at year 14 is approximately 17%.

The description of the line for Bulgaria omits the significant peak that occurs around year 16, where the value reaches its maximum for the period at approximately 27%. Instead, it incorrectly simplifies the trend between years 12 and 18.
The description states that the line for EU-27 ends at year 20. However, the red line in the chart clearly stops at year 19.
The description states that the value for Bulgaria at year 18 is about 22%. The chart shows the value is closer to 23%.
